RIGHTS OF PRE-EMPTION
1. The licensee or lessee shall use his best endervours to increase so far as possible with his
existing facilities. the supply of petroleum or petroleum products, or both. for the Federal

2. The licensee or lessee shall, with all reasonable expedition and so as to avoid demurrage
on the vessels conveying the same, use his best endeavours to deliver all petroleum or
petroleum producis purchases by the Minister under the right of pre-emption in such
quantities, and at such places of shipment or storage in Nigeria, as may be determined by
the Minister.
3. Where a vessel employed te carry petroleum or petroleum products under paragraph 2 is
detained on demurrage at the port of loading, the licensee or lessee shall pay the amount
due for demurrage according to the terms of the charter-party or the rates of loading
previously agreed to by the licensee or lessee, unless the delay is due to causes beyond
the control of the licensee or lessee.
4. Any dispute which may arise as to whether a delay is due to causes beyond the control of

or lessee or, in default of agreement, by arbitration.

delivery to be settled by agreement between the Minister and
